dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Only a handful of my more experimental dishes have made it onto the Wanmin Restaurant menu.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: In most cases, it's because I think the texture isn't quite right, or the flavor needs a lot more work... But that doesn't mean I'm about to give up.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I know there are tasty dishes out there waiting to be discovered, and I'll find them sooner or later!
